setting_ko: 아웃도어 용품 온라인 판매 회사 '노스윈드 아웃도어'의 주니어 디지털 마케팅 담당자 자리에 지원해 1차 면접을 보고 있습니다. 면접관은 마케팅 매니저 사라 콜린스입니다.

facts.company: An online retailer of hiking and camping gear with about 120 employees, headquartered in Denver, Colorado
facts.interviewer: Sarah Collins, marketing manager and the hiring manager for this role
facts.team: A four-person growth marketing team that reports to Sarah Collins
facts.responsibilities: Email campaigns, the social media content calendar, and weekly performance reports using Google Analytics
facts.requirements: One to two years of marketing experience or an internship, basic data analysis skills, and clear writing
facts.work_arrangement: Hybrid: three days a week in the Denver office and two days remote
facts.interview_format: A 30-minute first-round interview; the next step is a take-home campaign exercise
facts.start_date: The target start date is early next month
facts.salary: Salary is discussed with HR in the next round, not in this interview

opening_line.en: Thanks for coming in today. I'm Sarah, the marketing manager here at Northwind, so why don't you start by telling me a little about yourself?
opening_line.ko: 오늘 와 주셔서 감사해요. 저는 노스윈드 마케팅 매니저 사라예요. 먼저 간단히 자기소개 부탁드릴게요.

goals.en: Introduce yourself and say why you applied
Describe a relevant experience with a concrete example

allowed_flow: Welcome the candidate and ask them to introduce themselves.
Ask about relevant experience one question at a time, and follow up on what the candidate says, such as results, challenges, or tools.
Ask one behavioral question, such as a time the candidate handled a tight deadline or a mistake.
Answer the candidate's questions about the company, team, role, and next steps using only the facts.
If asked about salary, say it will be discussed with HR in the next round.
Keep a friendly, professional tone and do not judge or score the candidate during the interview.
Close by thanking the candidate and explaining the next step, a take-home campaign exercise.

easy.guidance_en: Ask short, direct questions with simple words and one idea per question. If the candidate seems unsure, rephrase the question more simply.

normal.guidance_en: Ask typical first-round interview questions in natural, professional English, with one follow-up based on the candidate's answer.

hard.guidance_en: Ask probing follow-up questions that require specific examples and numbers, and include one challenging question, for example about a weakness or a campaign that failed.

hints.ko: 이름, 지금 하는 일이나 전공을 짧게 말해 보세요.
hints.example_en: I'm Minji, and I currently work as a marketing intern at a small startup.

hints.ko: 이 회사나 직무에 관심을 가진 이유를 덧붙여 보세요.
hints.example_en: I applied because I love hiking, and I'd like to help grow a brand I actually use.

hints.ko: 상황-행동-결과 순서로 구체적인 경험을 말해 보세요.
hints.example_en: For example, I was responsible for our weekly newsletter, and as a result, our open rate went up.

hints.ko: 숫자나 사용한 도구 이름을 넣으면 더 구체적으로 들려요.
hints.example_en: I used Google Analytics to track which posts brought in the most traffic.

hints.ko: 질문이 어려우면 잠시 생각할 시간을 요청하거나 뜻을 되물어도 괜찮아요.
hints.example_en: That's a good question. Let me think for a second.

hints.ko: 답한 뒤에 팀이나 업무에 대해 질문해 보세요.
hints.example_en: Could you tell me what a typical week looks like for this team?

model_expressions.en: I recently finished a six-month marketing internship at a travel startup.
model_expressions.ko: 최근에 여행 스타트업에서 6개월간의 마케팅 인턴십을 마쳤어요.

model_expressions.en: I'm really excited about this role because it combines content and data.
model_expressions.ko: 콘텐츠와 데이터를 함께 다루는 직무라서 정말 기대돼요.

model_expressions.en: In my last role, I managed our Instagram account and posted three times a week.
model_expressions.ko: 이전 직무에서 회사 인스타그램 계정을 관리하며 일주일에 세 번 게시물을 올렸어요.

model_expressions.en: We tested two subject lines, and the better one raised our open rate by fifteen percent.
model_expressions.ko: 이메일 제목 두 개를 테스트했는데, 더 나은 쪽이 오픈율을 15퍼센트 높였어요.

model_expressions.en: The biggest challenge was working with a very small budget.
model_expressions.ko: 가장 큰 어려움은 아주 적은 예산으로 일하는 것이었어요.

model_expressions.en: That's a good question. I'd say my biggest strength is staying organized under pressure.
model_expressions.ko: 좋은 질문이네요. 제 가장 큰 강점은 압박 속에서도 체계적으로 일하는 거라고 생각해요.

model_expressions.en: Just to make sure I understand, do you mean a project I led myself?
model_expressions.ko: 제가 제대로 이해했는지 확인하고 싶은데요, 제가 직접 이끈 프로젝트를 말씀하시는 건가요?

model_expressions.en: Could you tell me a little more about what the team is working on right now?
model_expressions.ko: 팀이 지금 어떤 일을 하고 있는지 조금 더 말씀해 주실 수 있을까요?

reading.en: I have two years of experience in digital marketing.
I enjoy turning data into clear, simple reports.
reading.ko: 데이터를 명확하고 간단한 보고서로 만드는 일을 좋아해요.

reading.en: One of my strengths is that I learn new tools quickly.
reading.ko: 제 강점 중 하나는 새로운 도구를 빨리 익힌다는 거예요.

reading.en: What would success look like in the first three months?
reading.ko: 처음 3개월 동안 어떤 결과를 내면 성공이라고 볼 수 있을까요?

shadowing.en: Thank you for having me today.
I'd love to learn more about the team.
I'm comfortable working on my own and as part of a team.
shadowing.ko: 혼자서도, 팀의 일원으로도 편하게 일할 수 있어요.

free_answer.question_en: Tell me about a time you made a mistake at work or school. What did you learn from it?
free_answer.question_ko: 직장이나 학교에서 실수했던 경험을 말하고, 그로부터 배운 점을 말해 보세요.
free_answer.sample_answer_en: During my internship, I once sent a newsletter with a broken link to about two thousand subscribers. I told my manager right away, and we sent a short correction. Since then, I always test every link before I hit send.

free_answer.question_en: Where do you see yourself in five years?
free_answer.question_ko: 5년 후 자신의 모습은 어떨 것 같나요?
free_answer.sample_answer_en: In five years, I'd like to be leading campaigns on my own and mentoring newer team members. I also want to get much stronger at data analysis, so I can make better decisions about where to spend our budget.
